en_input: Monica, she will kill you. She will kill you like a dog in the street.
om: Mooniikaa, akka saree daandii irra jiruutti si ajjeessi.
back_madlad: May he kill you as he kills the horses on the road.
back_nllb: Monica, he will kill you like a dog in the street.

en_input: I can't. I have to take my grandmother to the animal doctor.
om: Anis hin dandaʼu, akkoo koo gara doktoora bineensotaatti geessuu qaba.
back_madlad: I couldn't, I had to go to a doctor.
back_nllb: I can't either, so I have to take my grandmother to the vet.

en_input: So you have to meet her by accident, but on purpose. And then act like you do not care.
om: Kanaaf, utuu hin beekin ishee wajjin wal arguu qabda, taʼus kaayyoodhaan, achiis akka waan hin yaadneetti jiraatta.
back_madlad: Therefore, he must communicate with her without hesitation, but with purpose, rather than as if he was not aware of her.
back_nllb: So you have to meet her without realizing it, but you do it on purpose and then as if you hadn't expected it.

en_input: No, I am truly sorry about Mark. Look, Rachel, I want only good things for you.
back_madlad: However, there is a lot of controversy about this.
back_nllb: No, I feel sorry for Mark.

en_input: A dog bed? For a dog?
It must take you hours to find your keys in there.
om: Achitti furtuu kee argachuun saʼaatii dheeraa si fudhachuu qaba.
back_madlad: It would take several hours to get to such a hole.
back_nllb: It will take you hours to find your keys.

en_input: I think you used your secret weapon, Gunther, too early.
om: Meeshaa waraanaa dhoksaa kee, Gunter, baayʼee dursitee akka fayyadamte natti fakkaata.
back_madlad: It appears that Gunther, his warrior brother, used it with a great deal of skill.
back_nllb: I think you used your secret weapon, Gunter, too early.

en_input: Oh no. What a terrible, terrible tragedy.
back_madlad: However, there are many who reject it.

en_input: Well, Albert has no friends. But he is very excited about the party. I think the only reason he is getting married is to see a stripper.
om: Albarti michoota hin qabu. Haataʼu malee ayyaanichaaf baayʼee gammadeera. Sababiin inni gaaʼela itti godhatu dubartii striptiist tokko ilaaluuf qofa akka taʼe natti fakkaata.
back_madlad: I had no hair, but I was very disappointed by the scene because it seemed to me that he was wearing a skirt just to see a stripper.
back_nllb: Albert has no friends, but he enjoys the party so much that I think he will marry just to see a stripper.
